blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: AI-generated videos often depict people within detailed scenes while leaving their small facial regions poorly resolved. Visual super-resolution can sharpen these regions without resolving whether the recovered lips and teeth agree with the spoken audio. We present an audio-guided facial video restoration framework that addresses this ambiguity within a reference-guided video flow model. Source--noise mixing initializes reconstruction from a partially preserved observation, and structured reference injection separates appearance anchors from continuous motion context. Training combines restoration of degraded images and videos with correction of degraded dubbed sources under target audio. Appearance and synchronization supervision allow the model to recover facial detail and support visual dubbing when the audio is replaced. On talking-head restoration benchmarks, our method achieves the best paired perceptual similarity and synchronization scores among the compared restoration methods. Component comparisons examine audio conditioning, the reconstruction formulation, and reference injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage. injection. Native AIGC examples further illustrate the recovery of lip contours, dental structure, and surrounding facial texture in scene-level footage.
blocks.zh: AI出品的视频常常在细节的场景中描写人们,同时让自己的小面部区域解不开. 视觉超分辨率可以使这些区域磨合而无需解决恢复的嘴唇和牙齿是否与口语音频一致. 我们提出了一个音频导面部视频修复框架,在参考导视频流模型中处理这一模糊性。 源-噪声相混合从部分保存的观测中初始化了重建,结构化的参考注射将外观锚与连续运动上下文相分离. 培训将恢复已退化的图像和录像与在目标音频下纠正已退化的被誉来源结合起来。 外观和同步监督可以使模型恢复面部细节,并在音频被替换后支持可视化的配音. 在对话头恢复基准方面,我们的方法在比较的恢复方法中实现了最好的对等感知相似性和同步分数。 组成部分比较审查音频调节、重建配方和参考注射。 原生AIGC的例子进一步说明了在场景级镜头中唇形轮廓,牙科结构以及周围面部纹理的恢复. 注射剂 原生AIGC的例子进一步说明了在场景级镜头中唇形轮廓,牙科结构以及周围面部纹理的恢复.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Audio-guided facial restoration from AIGC footage. Small facial regions provide limited evidence for lip and teeth structure. The model restores these regions using reference frames and accompanying audio. The three clips illustrate the source scenes and reconstructed heads; the reference bank depicts training-time conditioning. Quantitative references originate from the GT first frame. “Cat” denotes channel-wise fusion implemented by separate linear projections and summation.
blocks.zh: 图1:AIGC镜头的音频导面部修复. 小面部区域为唇和牙齿结构提供的证据有限. 该模型利用参考框和相伴音频恢复了这些区域. 这三段片段说明了源头场景并重建了头;参考库描绘了训练时调. 数量参考来源于GT第一框架. “Cat”表示通过单独的线性预测和总和进行信道式聚变。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generation models can synthesize detailed scenes and coordinated character motion [ 1 ] , yet a high-resolution frame does not necessarily contain a high-resolution face. In medium shots and full-body compositions, faces occupy only a small fraction of the image. Lip contours, individual teeth, and the oral cavity can remain blurred or poorly separated even when the surrounding scene is convincing. These defects become prominent during close viewing and reframing. Improving facial quality without regenerating an otherwise satisfactory shot is therefore an important step in downstream AIGC production.
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型可以合成详细的场景和协调字符运动 [1],然而高分辨框架并不一定包含高分辨面. 在中镜头和全身成分中,相貌只占据了画面的一小部分. 唇轮廓,单个牙齿,口腔即使周围的场景令人信服,仍会保持模糊或分离不良. 这些缺陷在近距离取景和反射时变得突出. 因此,改善面部质量而不重新产生本来令人满意的镜头是AIGC下游生产的一个重要步骤。

blocks.en: Video super-resolution addresses missing visual detail. SeedVR2 [ 2 ] uses generative priors for reconstruction, FlashVSR [ 3 ] targets efficient streaming restoration, and SparkVSR [ 4 ] introduces sparse high-quality keyframes for appearance control. For a speaking face, the desired detail also depends on articulation: lip contact determines tooth visibility, while mouth opening changes oral boundaries and occlusion. A plausible dental pattern can therefore disagree with the spoken sound. The restoration target must account for audio as well as visual appearance.
blocks.zh: 视频超解析地址缺失视觉细节. 种子VR2 [2] 使用基因前缀来进行重建,FlashVSR [3] 瞄准高效的流回修复,而SparkVSR [4] 引入了稀有的高质量外观控制键框. 对于说话的面孔,所期望的细节也取决于表达:唇接会决定了牙齿的能见度,而口腔开口则会改变口腔界限和闭塞. 因此,一种可信的牙科模式可能不同意口语声音。 恢复目标必须兼顾视听外观。

blocks.en: Audio provides information that can constrain this otherwise ambiguous reconstruction. Extreme-scale talking-face upsampling [ 5 ] combines audio with a high-resolution identity image; MDVD-Net [ 6 ] exploits multimodal cues for compressed face video; and GAVN [ 7 ] models temporal and identity information. We focus on low-quality AIGC faces whose observed oral structures or articulation may be unreliable. In this setting, restoring a sharp version of the source mouth is not always sufficient. The recovered lips and teeth must remain compatible with the accompanying audio throughout the reconstructed sequence.
blocks.zh: 音频提供信息,可以限制这种本来模棱两可的重建。 极端规模的谈话相貌取样 [5] 将音频与高分辨身份图像结合; MDVD-Net [6] 利用多模式提示来进行压缩相貌视频;以及 GAVN [7] 模式时空和身份信息. 我们侧重于低质量的AIGC面孔,其观察到的口腔结构或表达可能不可靠. 在这种背景下,恢复一个尖端的源口并不总是足够的. 恢复后的唇和牙齿必须在整个重建序列中与相伴的音频相容.

blocks.en: We address this problem with a reference-guided video flow model that uses audio during restoration. Its reconstruction trajectory begins from a source–noise mixture, preserving useful observations without making the source mouth a fixed target. Training first pairs degraded images and videos with clean targets. Audio-guided training additionally uses degraded dubbed sources whose mouth configuration differs from the target, requiring the model to follow the supplied speech rather than copy the input lips. Figure 1 illustrates the workflow, and Figure 2 details the learning objectives.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个参考指南的视频流模型来解决这个问题,该模型在恢复过程中使用音频. 其重建轨迹是从源-噪声混合物开始的,保存了有用的观测结果而不会使源口成为固定的目标. 培训第一对退化的图像和带干净目标的视频。 音频制导训练还额外使用了口腔配置与目标不同的已退化的被誉出源,要求模型遵循所提供语音而不是复制输入唇. 图1说明了工作流程,图2详细说明了学习目标。

blocks.en: Reference guidance presents a second challenge: a reference frame carries a particular pose and mouth configuration that may conflict with the current video. We assign independently encoded references and sequence-encoded history to distinct temporal slots. This structured injection provides a persistent appearance anchor while retaining recent motion context. It also avoids treating the reference mouth as a frame that the output must reproduce. In the quantitative evaluation, the reference source is the GT first frame; the enhanced-reference setting edits this same image.
blocks.zh: 参考指南提出了第二个挑战:参考框架带有特定的姿势和口腔配置,可能与当前视频相冲突. 我们将独立编码的参考文献和序列编码的历史分配给不同的时段。 这种有条理的注入在保留最近运动上下文的同时,提供了一个持续的外观锚. 这也避免了将参考口作为产出必须复制的框架来对待. 在定量评价中,参考出处为GT第一帧;增强参考设置会编辑这个相同的图像.

blocks.en: Visual dubbing tests this articulation-control capability under replacement audio. X-Dub [ 8 ] develops mask-free mouth editing, while VideoReTalking [ 9 ] combines lip editing with identity-aware enhancement. A conventional cascade restores appearance and then changes the mouth through a separate model. We evaluate whether our restoration framework retains recovered detail while following new audio, comparing it with super-resolution followed by released dubbing models. This complements the original-audio evaluation of facial restoration.
blocks.zh: 视觉欺骗测试这种在替换音频下的表达控制能力. X-Dub [8] 发展无口罩编辑,而VideoReTalking [9] 将唇语编辑与身份意识增强结合起来. 常规级联会恢复外观,再通过单独的型号来改变口腔. 我们评价我们的修复框架是否保留了回收的细节,同时遵循新的音频,将其与超解析度相比较,然后是释放出多功能模型。 这补充了面部修复的原声评价.

blocks.en: The contributions are threefold: ▶ \blacktriangleright An audio-guided facial video restoration framework that uses target speech to resolve ambiguous oral structure in low-quality footage, supporting both original-audio restoration and replacement-audio dubbing. ▶ \blacktriangleright A source–noise reconstruction formulation trained with visual-restoration and cross-articulation objectives. The latter uses mismatched source and target mouth configurations to supervise articulation correction. ▶ \blacktriangleright Structured reference injection with separate temporal slots for appearance anchors and continuous history. Component comparisons examine its role alongside audio conditioning and the source–noise formulation.
blocks.zh: 贡献有三:\\\ blacktriangleright(黑三角右) 一个音频导面相视频还原框架,使用目标语音解决低质量镜头中模棱两可的口语结构,支持原声修复和替换-音频双双相接. \\ 黑三角右转 源-噪声重建配方,以视觉修复和交叉渲染为目的。 后者使用不匹配的源和靶口配置来监督表达校正. \\ 黑三角右转 结构化的参考注射,为外观锚和连续历史分别设置了时间档. 组成部分比较除了音频调节和源-噪音配制外,还检查其作用。

blocks.en: An audio-guided facial video restoration framework that uses target speech to resolve ambiguous oral structure in low-quality footage, supporting both original-audio restoration and replacement-audio dubbing.
blocks.zh: 一个音频导面相视频还原框架,使用目标语音解决低质量镜头中模棱两可的口语结构,支持原声修复和替换-音频双双相接.

blocks.en: A source–noise reconstruction formulation trained with visual-restoration and cross-articulation objectives. The latter uses mismatched source and target mouth configurations to supervise articulation correction.
blocks.zh: 源-噪声重建配方,以视觉修复和交叉渲染为目的。 后者使用不匹配的源和靶口配置来监督表达校正.

blocks.en: Structured reference injection with separate temporal slots for appearance anchors and continuous history. Component comparisons examine its role alongside audio conditioning and the source–noise formulation.
blocks.zh: 结构化的参考注射,为外观锚和连续历史分别设置了时间档. 组成部分比较除了音频调节和源-噪音配制外,还检查其作用。

blocks.en: 2  Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Learned facial priors recover detail from degraded observations. GFP-GAN [ 10 ] and GPEN [ 11 ] use GAN priors, while CodeFormer [ 12 ] uses discrete high-quality representations. BSRGAN [ 13 ] and Real-ESRGAN [ 14 ] provide synthetic degradations for blind super-resolution. Image restoration methods such as StableSR [ 15 ] , DiffBIR [ 16 ] , and SUPIR [ 17 ] adapt diffusion priors to balance perceptual quality against fidelity to the observed image. Temporal propagation extends restoration to video: BasicVSR++ [ 18 ] uses recurrent propagation, RealBasicVSR [ 19 ] pre-cleans inputs, and KEEP [ 20 ] uses Kalman-inspired propagation.
blocks.zh: 学会了面部前科 从退化的观测中恢复细节 GFP-GAN [10]和GPEN [11]使用GAN前作,而CodeFormer [12]则使用离散的高质量表示. BSRGAN [13]和Real-ESRGAN [14]为盲超解提供合成降解. 图像还原方法,如StableSR [15],DiffBIR [16],和SUPIR [17] 调整传播前科,以平衡知觉质量与忠实度与被观测到的图像. 时间传播将修复延伸到视频: BasicVSR++ [18] 使用经常性传播,RealBasicVSR [19] 预清洁输入,而KEEP [20] 使用Kalman所启发的传播.

blocks.en: Upscale-A-Video [ 21 ] combines temporal diffusion with flow-guided latent propagation. SeedVR [ 22 ] uses a window-based video diffusion transformer, and SeedVR2 [ 2 ] studies one-step adversarial post-training. FlashVSR [ 3 ] targets efficient streaming restoration, while SparkVSR [ 4 ] propagates sparse high-quality keyframe guidance through low-resolution videos. We instead couple facial-detail recovery with target-audio control and cross-articulation supervision.
blocks.zh: 升级-A-Video [21] 将时间传播与流导潜在传播结合起来。 种子VR [22]使用以窗口为主的视频传播变压器,种子VR2 [2]研究了单步对抗后训练. FlashVSR [3] 的目标是高效的流回还原,而SparkVSR [4] 通过低分辨率视频传播稀有的高质量密钥框指导. 相反,我们把面部细节恢复 与靶机控制 和交叉渲染监督。

blocks.en: Wav2Lip [ 23 ] uses an expert synchronization objective, DINet [ 24 ] deforms reference features, and VideoReTalking [ 9 ] combines lip editing with identity-aware enhancement. LatentSync [ 25 ] and MuseTalk [ 26 ] operate in latent space; X-Dub [ 8 ] develops mask-free dubbing through generative bootstrapping. Unlike portrait animation such as AniPortrait [ 27 ] and EMO [ 28 ] , editing an existing video requires articulation changes while preserving source pose and non-articulatory motion.
blocks.zh: Wav2Lip [23] 使用专家同步目标,DINet [24] 变形参考功能,而VideoReTalking [9] 将唇语编辑与身份意识增强相结合. LatentSync [25]和MuseTalk [26] 在潜伏的空间中运行; X-Dub [8] 通过基因的靴子束缚来发展出无面具的配音. 与肖像动画如AniPortrait [27]和EMO [28] 不同,编辑一出已存在的视频需要在保持源头姿势和非相通运动的同时需要进行表达变化.

blocks.en: Audio can also constrain restoration. Extreme-scale talking-face upsampling [ 5 ] combines low-resolution video, audio, and an identity image. MDVD-Net [ 6 ] uses audio, geometry, and codec cues; GAVN [ 7 ] models complementary temporal and identity information. We focus on restoration when the observed mouth is unreliable or incompatible with replacement audio, and evaluate both original-audio reconstruction and cross-audio dubbing within the same framework.
blocks.zh: 音频也可以限制修复. 极端规模的"说话相"-取景[5]结合了低分辨率的视频,音频,以及身份图像. MDVD-Net [6] 使用音频,几何和编码提示; GAVN [7] 模式互补时间和身份信息. 我们注重在所观察的口腔不可靠或与替换音频不相容时进行修复,并在同一框架内评价原声-音频重建与跨音频双相接。

blocks.en: 3  Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Audio-guided facial video restoration. Stage 1 jointly trains on degraded images and videos with their corresponding targets. Images use only flow-matching MSE ( ℒ MSE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MSE}} ) and RGB losses; videos additionally use temporal supervision. Stage 2 uses degraded dubbed sources and target audio for lip correction. Sparse references and continuous history occupy distinct conditioning slots. The VAE, HuBERT, and SyncNet are frozen; the video DiT and conditioning projections are trainable. AIGC thumbnails illustrate the input and target roles.
blocks.zh: 图2:音频制导面部视频修复. 第一阶段联合对已退化的图像和视频及其相应目标进行培训。 图像只使用流相匹配的MSE(L MSE\mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{MSE}}})和RGB损失;视频额外使用时间监控. 第2阶段使用已退化的被誉为源和有目标的音频来进行唇音校正. 批量参考和连续历史占据了不同的条件档. VAE,HuBERT和SyncNet被冻结;视频DiT和调制预测可以被训练. AIGC缩略图说明了输入和目标角色.

blocks.en: Given a low-quality facial video X X , audio a a , and appearance references R R , we reconstruct a facial video in a latent flow model. Quantitative references originate from the GT first frame; training supports multiple sparse frames from the clean target. Figure 2 summarizes visual restoration followed by audio-guided lip correction. The model uses the same reconstruction interface for original and replacement audio.
blocks.zh: 由于一个低质量的面部视频X X, 音频一个, 和外观参考R R, 我们重建一个面部视频 在潜在流模型。 数量参考来源于GT第一帧;培训支持从干净的目标中取出多条稀有帧. 图2总结了视觉修复,然后是音频导嘴唇校正。 该模型对原声和重置音频使用相同的重建接口.

blocks.en: 3.1 Visual Restoration Objective
blocks.zh: 3.1 视觉恢复目标

blocks.en: The visual restoration objective pairs a high-quality image or video Y Y with its degraded observation X = 𝒟 ⁡ ( Y ) X=\mathcal{D}(Y) . Inputs are resized back to the target’s grid before encoding, so restoration recovers missing detail at a common spatial resolution. A frozen causal video autoencoder ( E , D ) (E,D) maps images and videos to a shared latent space, and a Wan [ 1 ] video DiT predicts their reconstruction. Image examples supervise appearance; video examples additionally supervise temporal changes.
blocks.zh: 视觉还原目标对一高品质的图像或视频 Y Y 与其退化的观测X = D ⁡ (Y) X=\ mathcal{ D} (Y). 输入在编码前被调整回目标网格上,因此恢复会在共同的空间分辨率下恢复缺失的细节. 一个被冻结的因果视频自动编码器(E, D (E, D))将图像和视频映射到一个共享的潜伏空间,而一个Wan [1] 视频DiT预测它们的重建. 图像实例监督外观;视频实例额外监督时间变化.

blocks.en: A reference may depict a pose or mouth configuration that conflicts with the current motion. We therefore inject it as an appearance condition, not a prescribed output frame. Sparse clean frames anchor identity and texture, while a separate sequence of four adjacent frames supplies local motion context. Each sparse frame is encoded independently, and history is encoded as a sequence. Their features occupy disjoint temporal positions in a reference canvas; unused positions are zero. A shared projection adds this canvas to the DiT input features without replacing the denoising state with reference or history latents. The reference is thus available throughout reconstruction without forcing the output to copy its mouth configuration. Section 3.3 specifies how the GT first frame and generated history populate these conditions during quantitative inference.
blocks.zh: 引用可能描绘出与当前运动相冲突的姿势或口腔配置. 因此,我们把它作为一个外观条件,而不是一个规定的产出框架。 Sparse clean frame socket 身份和纹理,而由相邻的四帧组成的单独序列则提供局部运动上下文. 每个稀疏相框被独立地编码,而历史被编码为一个序列. 它们的特点在参考画布中占据了不相连的时间位置;未使用的位置为零. 共享投影将这幅画布添加到 DiT 输入特性中,而不以参考或历史潜想取代去名状态. 因此,在整个重建过程中都可以使用该参考文献,而不必强迫输出复制其口腔配置. 第3.3节具体规定了GT第一个框架和生成的历史如何在定量推论中体现这些条件。

blocks.en: Multiple sparse references provide coverage of appearance changes. Training uses 77-frame windows corresponding to 20 temporal latents. Appearance and history conditions are independently dropped with probabilities 0.1 and 0.4; audio-conditioned training additionally drops audio with probability 0.1. This conditioning dropout discourages dependence on a single cue.
blocks.zh: 多个稀有的参考文献提供了外观变化的覆盖面. 培训使用与20个时间潜伏物相对应的77个框架窗口。 外观和历史条件以概率0.1和0.4独立降出;有音频条件的训练再以概率0.1降出音频. 这一条件限制了对单一提示的依赖。

blocks.en: For video examples, flow supervision learns the latent reconstruction trajectory while decoded losses constrain appearance and temporal changes: ℒ rec = ℒ flow + 0.1 ​ ℒ RGB + 0.1 ​ ℒ Δ + 0.1 ​ ℒ LPIPS . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{flow}}+0.1\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{RGB}}+0.1\mathcal{L}_{\Delta}+0.1\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{LPIPS}}. (3) The flow term is time-weighted velocity MSE, denoted ℒ MSE \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{MSE}} in Figure 2 , with twice the weight in the mouth region. RGB MSE preserves image structure, LPIPS [ 30 ] supervises perceptual appearance, and ℒ Δ \mathcal{L}_{\Delta} matches adjacent-frame differences. Still images use only ℒ flow + 0.1 ​ ℒ RGB \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{flow}}+0.1\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{RGB}} , without perceptual or temporal losses. Video decoding samples a four-latent window, using detached preceding predictions as causal context for temporal continuity.
blocks.zh: 以影片为例, L reg = L流量 + 0.1 LRGB + 0.1 LQ + 0.1 LPIPS . & mathcal {L}_{\ mathrm {rec}}=\mathcal {L}_{\ mathrm { flow {0}}+ 1\ mathrm {RGB}}+0\ 1\ matthcal {L}_{\ Delta}+0}+0\ 1\ mathcal {L}_{\ mathrm {LPIPS}}. (3)流量名词是时间加权速度MSE,表示L MSE\mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{MSE}在图2中,重量是口区重量的两倍. RGB MSE保留了图像结构,LPIPS [30] 监督知觉外观,而L  \ mathcal{L}_{\Delta}匹配相邻-帧差异. 静态图像只使用L流+0.1 L RGB\mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{flow}}+0.1\mathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{RGB}}},没有知觉或时间损失. 视频解码取出一个四相相通的窗口,将之前的分解预测作为时间连续性的因果关系.

blocks.en: 3.2 Audio-Guided Lip Correction
blocks.zh: 3.2 音频指导口腔矫正

blocks.en: Restoring an unreliable mouth requires reconstruction beyond the observed source pixels. The articulation-correction objective uses a dubbed source X dub X^{\mathrm{dub}} and a clean target Y Y that share the person and scene but differ in articulation. We degrade the dubbed source to obtain X = 𝒟 ⁡ ( X dub ) X=\mathcal{D}(X^{\mathrm{dub}}) and condition reconstruction on the audio of Y Y . Reproducing the source mouth is therefore insufficient: the target requires both detail recovery and a change in oral configuration. With source–noise mixing, oral configuration is reconstructed rather than fixed by the input.
blocks.zh: 恢复不可靠的口需要重建超过观测到的源像素. 发音-校正目标使用被被誉为源 X dub X^{\mathrm{dub}} 和 干净的目标 Y Y, 分享人物和场景,但发音不同. 我们贬低被誉为X = D (X dub ) 的源,以获得 X = D (X dub ) X=\ mathcal{ D} (X^{\ mathrm{ dub}} ) ,并以 Y Y 的音频作为重建的条件. 因此,复制源口是不够的:目标既需要细节恢复,也需要改变口腔配置. 随着源-噪声相混合,口腔配置被重建而不是由输入来固定.

blocks.en: Frozen HuBERT [ 31 ] features pass through a trainable audio projection and condition the DiT on the video timeline. The projection aligns speech features with the reconstruction windows, providing an audio condition alongside the visual inputs.
blocks.zh: Frozen HuBERT [31] 功能通过可列车的音频投影,并在视频时间表上为DiT设定条件. 投影将语音功能与重建窗口相配合,提供与视觉输入相伴的音频条件.

blocks.en: Synchronization complements the paired losses: ℒ stage2 = ℒ rec + λ sync ​ ℒ sync . \mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{stage2}}=\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rec}}+\lambda_{\mathrm{sync}}\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{sync}}. (4) We use a frozen SyncNet for synchronization supervision, following Wav2Lip [ 23 ] . The audio-guided configuration uses λ sync = 10 − 4 \lambda_{\mathrm{sync}}=10^{-4} .
blocks.zh: 同步补充了已配对的损失: L stage2 = L rec + + QQ 同步 L. \ mathcal{ L}_{\-mathrm{ stage2}}=\-matathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{rec}}+\-lambda_{\-mathrm{sync}}\-matathcal{L}_{\-mathrm{sync}}. (4)在Wav2Lip[23]之后,我们使用被冻结的同步网络进行同步监督. 音频引导配置使用QQ同步 = 10 – 4\lambda_{\mathrm{sync}}=10^{-4}.

blocks.en: 3.3 Temporally Conditioned Inference
blocks.zh: 3.3 临时有条件的推断

blocks.en: Videos are reconstructed in overlapping temporal windows with a fixed appearance reference r r . For quantitative evaluation, Ours uses the GT first frame, whereas Ours + uses its GPT-Image-enhanced version. Both configurations use 512 × 512 512\times 512 references and the same sampler, without output post-processing. For native AIGC footage without GT, the reference is prepared from the input first frame.
blocks.zh: 视频在相重叠的时间窗口中被重塑,并带有固定的外观参考r r. 关于定量评估, Ours使用GT第一帧,而Ours +使用其GPT-Image-增强版. 两种配置都使用512×512 512\times 512参考和同样器,不输出后处理. 对于没有GT的原生AIGC镜头,参考材料由输入第一帧编写.

blocks.en: For a subsequent window k k , let τ \tau denote the index of the last retained output frame from the preceding window. We combine the fixed appearance reference with the four most recent reconstructed frames to form the next window’s conditioning sequence: P k = [ r , y ^ τ − 3 , y ^ τ − 2 , y ^ τ − 1 , y ^ τ ] . P_{k}=\bigl[r,\hat{y}_{\tau-3},\hat{y}_{\tau-2},\hat{y}_{\tau-1},\hat{y}_{\tau}\bigr]. (5) The reference is encoded independently to provide appearance guidance, while the second temporal latent of E ⁡ ( P k ) E(P_{k}) supplies recent motion context. These features populate their respective conditioning slots. The initial window uses five copies of r r because no generated history is available. Subsequent windows use only previously reconstructed frames, without future target frames.
blocks.zh: 对于随后的窗口 k k, 请 \ tau 表示上一个窗口中最后一个保留输出框的索引 。 我们把固定的外观参照物与最近四个重建的相框结合起来,形成下个窗口的调制序列: P k = [r, y ^ − 3, y → − 2, y → − 1, y ]. P_{k}=\bigl [r,\hat{y}_{\tau-3},\hat{y}_{\tau-2},\hat{y}_{\tau-1},\hat{y}_{\tau}\bigr]. (5) 引用是独立编码的,以提供外观指导,而E ⁡ (Pk) E (P_{k})的第二个时间潜伏提供了最近的运动上下文. 这些功能充斥着各自的调节槽. 初始窗口使用 r 的五份副本, 因为没有生成的历史 。 随后的窗口只使用之前重建的帧,没有未来的目标帧.

blocks.en: The last retained RGB frame is also encoded independently as E ⁡ ( y ^ τ ) E(\hat{y}_{\tau}) , providing an additional appearance condition at the transition to new content. Although this frame is part of P k P_{k} , its independent encoding serves a different role from the sequence-encoded motion context. Within the overlapping region, the preceding window’s latent trajectory is replayed at matching flow times. Source observations, noise, and audio conditions remain aligned to the same video timeline.
blocks.zh: 最后被保留的 RGB 框架也被独立编码为 E \\ (y \\\\\\\) E(\hat{\\\ tau}),在向新内容过渡时提供了额外的外观条件. 虽然这个框架是Pk P_{k}的一部分,但其独立的编码服务与序列编码的运动上下文不同. 在重叠区域内,前一窗口的潜入轨迹在相匹配的流量时重现。 源头观测、噪音和音频条件仍然与同一视频时间表一致。

blocks.en: The causal-VAE decoder processes the first window and preserves its internal state when decoding newly retained latents from subsequent windows. Each window contains five conditioning frames and 72 payload frames; stride 56 gives 16 overlapping payload frames. Discarding the conditioning prefix and duplicated overlap yields the original video duration. No RGB cross-fading or histogram matching is applied.
blocks.zh: 因果-VAE解码器处理第一个窗口,并在解码后续窗口新保留的潜伏物时保留其内部状态. 每个窗口包含5个调制框和72个有效载荷框;行进图56给出了16个相重叠的有效载荷框. 丢弃调值前缀和重复的相重叠产生出原始视频持续时间. 不应用 RGB 横断面或直方图匹配 。

blocks.en: 4  Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: We evaluate facial restoration under original audio, articulation control under replacement audio, and native AIGC footage. Ablations examine audio conditioning, source–noise mixing, and structured reference injection.
blocks.zh: 我们用原始音频评估面部修复,用替换音频评估表达控制,以及原生的AIGC镜头. 检查音频调节、源-噪声混合和结构化的参考注射。

blocks.en: Both quantitative comparisons use seed 42, source noise 0.8, ten Euler steps, shift 5, audio guidance 4, and reference guidance 1.5.
blocks.zh: 两种定量比较都使用种子42,源噪0.8,十个欧拉步骤,转向5,音频指导4和参考指导1.5.

blocks.en: 4.1 Facial Restoration under Original Audio
blocks.zh: 4.1 原声片下的外形修复

blocks.en: The benchmark contains 150 videos from MEAD [ 32 ] , HDTF [ 33 ] , TalkVid [ 34 ] , and our internal talking-head dataset. All methods receive the same training-style degradation, including 4 × 4\times downsampling and resizing back to 512 × 512 512\times 512 . Table 1 reports equal-video means over the common valid clips. Metrics are computed on complete prepared frames using native uncompressed RGB outputs.
blocks.zh: 基准包含来自MEAD [32],HDTF [33],TalkVid [34]的150个视频,以及我们内部的谈话头数据组. 所有方法都得到相同的训练式退化,包括4×4\时间的下采样和回缩到512×512512\时间512. 表1报告为平面视频,指超过常见的有效片段。 度量衡是使用当地未压缩的RGB输出,在完整的准备框架上计算出来的。

blocks.en: The baselines span face restoration with GPEN [ 11 ] and CodeFormer [ 12 ] ; reference-guided restoration with InstantRestore [ 35 ] , SparkVSR [ 4 ] , and RG-FVR [ 36 ] ; and video restoration with SeedVR2 [ 2 ] and three FlashVSR [ 3 ] variants. Baselines retain their released interfaces and sampling budgets.
blocks.zh: 基线跨度为GPEN[11]和CodeFormer[12];以InstantRestore[35]、SparkVSR[4]和RG-FVR[36]为基准的参考制导还原;以SeedVR2[2]和三个FlashVSR[3]变体为基准的视频还原。 基线保留其释放的接口和取样预算。

blocks.en: In Table 1 , all baselines that support an external reference and Ours receive the same undegraded GT first frame, not the first frame of the degraded input. Ours + uses a GPT-Image-enhanced version of that frame, with the model and sampler unchanged. This additional row examines the effect of reference enhancement. Methods without a reference interface use only their supported inputs.
blocks.zh: 在表1中,所有支持外部参考和Ours的基线都得到相同的未降级的GT第一个框架,而不是退化输入的第一个框架. Ours +使用GPT-Image-增强版的这个帧,模型和采样器不变. 增加一行审查增强参考的效果。 没有参考界面的方法仅使用其支持的投入.

blocks.en: We report the metrics shown in Tables 1 and 2 . PSNR [ 37 ] and SSIM [ 38 ] measure pixel and structural fidelity; LPIPS [ 30 ] and DISTS [ 39 ] measure paired perceptual similarity. Sync-C ↑ \uparrow and Sync-D ↓ \downarrow assess audiovisual agreement with frozen SyncNet-v2 [ 40 ] . MUSIQ [ 41 ] and CLIP-IQA [ 42 ] estimate no-reference frame quality, while FasterVQA [ 43 ] and DOVER [ 44 ] estimate no-reference video quality. Paired metrics are used only when a corresponding target video is available.
blocks.zh: 我们报告表1和表2所示的衡量标准。 同步 。 C \ oparrow and Sync-D \ downarrow 评估与被冻结的 SyncNet-v2 [40] . MUSIQ [41] 和 CLIP-IQA [42] 估计无参考帧质量,而更快速VQA [43] 和 DOV[44] 估计无参考视频质量. 只有当有相应的目标视频时,才使用Paired度量衡.

blocks.en: Table 1: Facial restoration under original audio. Results on the 150-video benchmark, averaged equally over common valid clips. Darker and lighter green mark the best and second-best results, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表1:原声下外形修复. 150视频基准的结果,平均比普通有效短片平均。 更暗和更轻的绿色标记分别是最佳和第二好的结果.

blocks.en: Table 1 shows that Ours achieves Sync-C/D of 7.413/7.561, compared with 6.545/8.170 for SparkVSR [ 4 ] , the strongest restoration baseline on these synchronization measures. Ours also has the lowest LPIPS (0.0793) and DISTS (0.0858), improving on InstantRestore [ 35 ] at 0.1380/0.1421. SparkVSR retains the highest PSNR (30.62) and SSIM (0.8863), exceeding Ours by 1.95 dB and 0.0027. The results therefore favor different methods under different criteria: SparkVSR leads pixel fidelity, whereas Ours leads paired perceptual similarity and synchronization among the compared restoration models.
blocks.zh: 表1显示,我们的同步C/D达到7.413/7.561,而SparkVSR[4]的同步C/D则达到6.545/8.170,这是这些同步措施上最强的恢复基线. 我们的LPIPS(0.0793)和DISTS(0.0858)也是最低的,以0.1380/0.1421. SparkVSR保留了最高的PSNR (30.62)和SSIM (0.8863),比Ours多出1.95分贝和0.027. 因此,结果倾向于采用不同标准下的不同方法: SparkVSR引导像素忠诚度,而Ours则引导在相比较的还原模型中对等的感官相似性和同步性.

blocks.en: The perceptual gains occur without the enhanced reference used by Ours + . With the GT first frame, Ours reconstructs the sequence at 28.67 dB PSNR and 0.8836 SSIM while reducing perceptual error. This separates the reconstruction model’s performance from the additional appearance changes introduced by reference editing.
blocks.zh: 知觉收益在没有我们+使用强化参考的情况下出现. 以GT第一帧,Ours重建了28.67 dB PSNR和0.8836 SSIM的序列,同时减少感知错误. 这把重建模型的性能与参考编辑引入的额外外观变化区分开来.

blocks.en: Ours + achieves the highest MUSIQ (77.62), CLIP-IQA (0.7081), FasterVQA (0.8997), and DOVER (0.8823), with GPEN [ 11 ] second on all four. Its Sync-C/D is 7.453/7.520. Relative to Ours with the GT first frame, reference enhancement shifts the fidelity–quality balance: PSNR decreases from 28.67 to 23.52 and LPIPS increases from 0.0793 to 0.2402. The enhanced reference favors visually detailed reconstruction, while the unenhanced reference better preserves the target appearance. The GT row serves as an undegraded source reference and is excluded from method rankings.
blocks.zh: 我们的+实现了最高的MUSIQ(77.62),CLIP-IQA(0.7081),更快的VQA(0.8997)和DOVER(0.8823),GPEN[11]在所有四强中名列第二. 其Sync-C/D为7.453/7.520. 与具有GT第一框架的Ours相比,参考增强转移了忠诚-质量平衡:PSNR从28.67降至23.52,LPIPS从0.0793增至0.2402. 增强的参考偏好视觉上详细的重建,而未增强的参考则能更好地保存目标外观. GT行作为未降级的源参考,被排除在方法排名之外.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cross-audio Dubbing
blocks.zh: 4.2 交叉视听

blocks.en: Replacement-audio dubbing tests whether the restoration model can follow new audio without a separate mouth-editing stage. We compare its reconstruction with FlashVSR Full [ 3 ] or SparkVSR [ 4 ] followed by X-Dub [ 8 ] , KeySync [ 45 ] , TBDub [ 46 ] (Teacher or Student), or LipForcing [ 47 ] . All pipelines use the same degraded source and replacement audio, with no additional degradation between stages. SparkVSR and Ours + receive the same GPT-Image-enhanced GT first frame. Table 2 reports synchronization and no-reference quality because replacement audio has no paired target-mouth video.
blocks.zh: 重置-自动调试测试修复模型是否能够在不单独进行口腔编辑阶段的情况下遵循新音频. 我们将其重建与FlashVSR Full [3] 或 SparkVSR [4] 相比较,然后是 X-Dub [8], KeySync [45], TBDub [46] (教师或学生), 或 LipForcing [47]. 所有管线都使用同一种已退化的源和被替换的音频,在相位之间没有再退化. SparkVSR和Ours +获得相同的GPT-Image-增强GT第一帧. 表2报告同步和无参考质量,因为替换音频没有配对的目标口视频.

blocks.en: Table 2: Visual dubbing under replacement audio. Equal-video means on the same 30 clips and replacement-audio pairs. Darker and lighter green mark the best and second-best method results.
blocks.zh: 表2: 替换音频下的视觉配音。 等相影指同30个片段和替换-音频对. 更深更浅的绿色标记是最佳和第二好的方法结果.

blocks.en: Ours + leads all ten cascades on the six metrics in Table 2 . Its Sync-C/D of 8.175/7.083 improves on the strongest synchronization cascade, FlashVSR Full followed by LipForcing (7.917/7.186), by 0.258 and 0.103, respectively. MUSIQ reaches 77.56, exceeding the best cascade score of 74.12 from SparkVSR followed by X-Dub by 3.44. DOVER reaches 0.8709 versus 0.7845 for FlashVSR Full followed by X-Dub, a gain of 0.0864. Ours + also ranks first in CLIP-IQA and FasterVQA. The strongest cascade depends on the criterion: LipForcing leads synchronization, whereas X-Dub leads several quality measures. Ours + retains both advantages within a single reconstruction pipeline.
blocks.zh: 我们的+带领所有10个级联在表2中的6个度量标准上. 其8.175/7.083的同步C/D改进了最强同步级联FlashVSR 完全接踵而来的是LipForcing (7.917/7.186),分别以0.258和0.103. MUSIQ达到了77.56分,超过了从SparkVSR获得的74.12分的最佳级联分数,而后X-Dub以3.44分. FlashVSR的Dover达到0.8709比0.7845 完全跟随X-Dub,收益为0.0864. 我们的+在CLIP-IQA和更快VQA中也排名第一. 最大级联取决于标准: LipForcing引出同步,而X-Dub引出若干质量度量. 我们+在单一的重建管道中保留着两个优势.

blocks.en: 4.3 Native AIGC Restoration and Dubbing
blocks.zh: 4.3 土著AIGC修复和配置

blocks.en: Figure 3 complements the two quantitative comparisons with four native MiniMax-H3 [ 48 ] text-to-audio-video clips, without additional synthetic input degradation or paired clean targets. Source-scene views locate the matched-time head crops, and word-level IPA annotations identify the corresponding audio segments. Here the input first frame, rather than a GT first frame, is edited with GPT-Image; the resulting reference is shared by reference-capable methods and Ours + .
blocks.zh: 图3补充了两个定量比较,四个原生的MiniMax-H3 [48]文本到Audio-video剪辑,没有额外的合成输入降解或配对的清洁目标. source-scene视图定位匹配时头作物,而单词级IPA说明识别出相应的音频段. 在此,输入第一帧,而不是GT第一帧,由GPT-Image编辑;由此产生的参考文献由可参考方法和Ours +.

blocks.en: Figure 3: Facial detail and articulation in AIGC scenes. Four MiniMax-H3 [ 48 ] clips are shown with matched-time head crops located by orange boxes. Left: restoration under original audio. Right: FlashVSR Full (top) or SparkVSR (bottom) is followed by the arrow-marked dubbing methods; Input and SR-only outputs provide visual controls. Ours + jointly reconstructs detail and articulation with a GPT-Image-enhanced reference, without an external SR frontend. Waveforms and word-level IPA labels identify the audio segments. Displayed predictions are unretouched.
blocks.zh: 图3:AIGC场景中的外观细节和表达. 4个MiniMax-H3 [48]片段显示的是橙色盒所定位的匹配时头作物. 左:在原声下恢复. 右:FlashVSR Full (top) 或 SparkVSR (下方) 之后是箭头标记的配音方法; 输入和仅SR输出提供可视化控制. Ours + 联合重建细节并用GPT- Image-增强的参考来表达,没有外部的SR前端. 波形和词级IPA标签识别出音频片段. 显示的预测没有调整 。

blocks.en: GPEN [ 11 ] produces sharp facial detail in individual frames, but its framewise formulation does not explicitly enforce temporal consistency. Sharpness alone also does not resolve dental structure: in the male example, FlashVSR Tiny and Full retain soft tooth boundaries, while SparkVSR shows weak separation between adjacent teeth. Ours + delineates the upper teeth and lip–skin boundary more clearly while recovering detailed beard texture. In the female example, it combines distinct lip contours and visible upper teeth with fine hair strands.
blocks.zh: GPEN [11] 在单个帧中产生尖锐的面部细节,但其框架式配方并没有明确强制时间一致性. 尖锐性本身并不能解决牙科结构:在男性例子中,FlashVSR 小而全能地保留了软牙边界,而SparkVSR则显示出相邻牙齿之间的弱分. 我们的+在恢复细长胡子纹理的同时,更清楚地划定了上牙和唇皮的界限。 在雌性的例子中,它结合了明显的唇轮廓和可见的上牙与细细的发丝.

blocks.en: The right half exposes how dubbing changes an already restored face. With FlashVSR Full as the frontend, KeySync visibly deforms the beard and chin boundary; with SparkVSR, it changes lip geometry and color, while LipForcing leaves the lower face comparatively soft. Ours + preserves beard texture around the male subject’s mouth and produces a distinct lip contour and exposed upper teeth for the female subject. These matched-time crops show where the pipelines differ spatially, complementing the video-level measurements in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 右半部分揭示了欺骗如何改变一个已经恢复的相貌. 用闪光VSR 完全作为前端,KeySync明显地使胡子和下巴边界变形;用SparkVSR,它会改变唇几何和颜色,而LipForcing则会使下面相对柔软. 我们的+保留了雄性主体口部的胡子纹理,为雌性主体产生了明显的唇形轮廓并暴露出上牙. 这些相匹配的作物表明输油管的空间差异,补充了表2中的视频级测量。

blocks.en: 4.4 Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.4 读取研究

blocks.en: We compare four configurations on the same 30 videos to examine audio conditioning, source–noise mixing, and structured reference injection. All receive identical degraded inputs and original audio, where used, with the corresponding unenhanced GT first frame as the reference. Table 3 reports their scores, and Figure 4 shows matched-frame outputs with GT. Reference enhancement is disabled throughout this study so that the comparisons focus on reconstruction components.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了这30个视频上的4个配置,以检查音频调节、源噪混合和结构化的参考注射。 全部接收相同的退化输入和原始音频,在使用时,以相应的未增强的GT第一帧作为参考. 表3报告了它们的分数,而图4显示的是与GT相匹配的框架产出。 在整个研究中,参考资料的改进被禁用,因此比较的重点是重建部分。

blocks.en: Table 3: Ablation comparison on the same 30 videos: 15 from MEAD [ 32 ] and 15 from HDTF [ 33 ] . All variants use the GT first frame. X-Dub [ 8 ] and DirectMotion provide alternatives to source–noise mixing and structured reference injection, respectively. Values are video-wise means; GT is excluded from rankings. Dark and light green mark the best and second-best model results.
blocks.zh: 表3:同30个视频的对比:15个来自MEAD[32],15个来自HDTF[33]. 所有变体都使用GT第一帧. X-Dub [8] 和 Direct Motion分别提供了源-噪声混合和结构化参考注射的替代品. 数值是视频手段;GT被排除在排名之外. 黑暗和浅绿色标记最佳和二等模型结果.

blocks.en: This variant restores the degraded video using visual and reference conditions without audio. In Figure 4 , row 2, column 6, its mouth opening is narrower than GT in column 2; Ours in column 4 reconstructs the open-mouth configuration. Although the visual-only variant attains slightly higher PSNR, its Sync-C/D of 4.283/10.524 is worse than 7.621/7.560 for Ours. Its fidelity advantage is limited to 0.26 dB in PSNR and 0.0037 in SSIM, while LPIPS remains nearly unchanged (0.0856 versus 0.0850). The larger synchronization difference, together with the visible mouth-opening error, distinguishes articulation recovery from overall pixel fidelity. Audio supplies complementary information for reconstructing mouth configurations that degraded visual evidence alone leaves ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 这个变体利用没有音频的视觉和参考条件恢复已退化的视频. 在图4第2行第6行中,它的口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口口 虽然只视觉的变体得到的PSNR略高,但其Sync-C/D为4.283/10.524,比Ours的7.621/7.560差. 它的忠诚优势在PSNR中仅限于0.26分贝,在SSIM中仅限于0.0037分贝,而LPIPS则几乎保持不变(0.0856分比0.0850分贝. 较大的同步相差,加上明显的开口出错,将通畅恢复与整体像素忠诚区分开来. 音频为重建口腔配置提供了补充信息,而光是视觉证据就退化了。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Qualitative ablation comparison. Each row shows two selected frames from one clip: MEAD [ 32 ] (top) and HDTF [ 33 ] (bottom). The same frame pair is displayed for GT and each model variant, with ten images per row. All variants use the GT first frame, and predictions are extracted directly from native RGB outputs.
blocks.zh: 图4:定性萎缩比较。 每行显示一个剪辑中选取的两个帧:MEAD [32] (上)和HDTF [33] (下). GT和每个模型变体都显示同一帧对,每行有10个图像. 所有变体都使用GT第一帧,预测直接取自原生的RGB输出.

blocks.en: We compare our reconstruction formulation with restoration-adapted X-Dub [ 8 ] . This variant incorporates our reference-frame injection logic: the GT first frame is encoded independently and placed in the appearance-conditioning slot, while motion history occupies a separate temporal slot. It receives the same GT first frame and audio as Ours. Instead of source–noise mixing, reconstruction starts from Gaussian noise, with the degraded video supplied through dense latent conditions. The appearance reference thus remains explicitly available while the source enters through a different conditioning route. This comparison examines an alternative source-conditioning strategy for recovering the target face from a degraded observation.
blocks.zh: 我们把我们的重建配方与恢复后适应的X-Dub[8]进行比较. 这个变体包含了我们的参考-帧注射逻辑:GT第一个帧独立编码并放入外观-调节槽,而运动历史则占据了单独的时段. 它接收与"Ours"相同的GT第一帧和音频. 重建并非来源-噪音混合,而是从高斯噪音开始,退化的视频通过密集的潜在条件提供。 因此,当来源通过不同的条件路线进入时,外观参考仍然明确可用。 这一比较审查了从退化的观测中恢复目标面的替代源调战略。

blocks.en: Despite higher MUSIQ and CLIP-IQA scores, the adapted model matches the reference appearance less closely. Figure 4 , row 1, columns 9–10, shows over-emphasized skin texture; row 2, column 10, exhibits coarse facial detail and hard dental edges. Its PSNR/LPIPS of 26.63/0.1523, versus 29.10/0.0850 for Ours, reflects greater reconstruction error. Sync-C/D is also worse, at 7.407/8.144. These results favor our source–noise formulation over the adapted dubbing formulation for preserving facial appearance while following audio. Stronger apparent sharpness alone does not recover the reference’s skin texture or dental boundaries.
blocks.zh: 尽管MUSIQ和CLIP-IQA的分数较高,但被改编的模型与参考外观相匹配较少. 图4, 第1行, 第9-10栏, 显示过度强调的皮肤纹理; 第2行, 第10栏, 显示粗糙的面部细节和硬牙边缘。 它的PSNR/LPIPS为26.63/0.1523,而29.10/0.0850为: 我们的,反映了更大的重建错误。 Sync-C/D也更糟,在7.407/8.144. 这些结果有利于我们源头的噪音配方, 单靠更强的表面锐度并不能恢复参考物的皮肤纹理或牙科界限。

blocks.en: DirectMotion replaces the structured reference canvas with direct motion-frame conditioning. The first window repeats the GT first frame five times; subsequent windows use the preceding output’s last five frames. Thus, later windows carry forward generated appearance instead of receiving a persistent, independently injected GT first frame. This changes how the model accesses the fixed reference as reconstruction proceeds.
blocks.zh: Direct Motion将结构化的参考画布取而代之的是直接的活性帧调节. 第一个窗口重复了GT的第一个帧五次;随后的窗口使用前一个输出的最后五个帧. 因此,后期窗口将生成的外观向前推进,而不是接收一个持续,独立注入的GT第一帧. 这改变了模型如何获得固定的重建收益。

blocks.en: In Figure 4 , row 1, columns 7–8, facial texture becomes overly smooth, while row 2, columns 7–8, exhibits artificial dot patterns. Both are consistent with errors accumulating through generated history and weakening the reference condition. DirectMotion obtains PSNR/LPIPS of 28.24/0.1341, compared with 29.10/0.0850 for Ours. Its Sync-C/D of 7.254/7.875 also trails Ours at 7.621/7.560. The results support structured reference injection: an appearance anchor remains directly accessible in later windows, instead of being inherited only through previously generated frames.
blocks.zh: 在图4中,第1行,第7至8行,面部纹理变得过于平滑;而第2行,第7至8行,展示了人工点图案. 两者都与通过生成的历史积累出的错误相一致并削弱了参考条件。 Direct Motion获得28.24/0.1341的PSNR/LPIPS,而 我们的29.10/0.0850,它的同步C/D为7254/7.875 线索 我们的电话是7.621/7.560 结果支持结构化的参考注射:一个外观主锚仍然可以在后期窗口直接取用,而不是仅仅通过先前生成的帧来继承.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We present a facial video restoration framework in which target audio participates directly in reconstruction. The original-audio comparison yields lower paired perceptual error and better synchronization scores than the evaluated restoration baselines. Replacement-audio experiments examine visual dubbing without a separate mouth-editing model, and native AIGC examples illustrate recovery of facial regions within larger scenes. Component comparisons connect the observed behavior to audio conditioning, source–noise mixing, and structured reference injection. Together, these results support a reference-guided approach to downstream facial restoration and dubbing.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个面部视频修复框架,目标音频直接参与重建。 与评估的还原基线相比,原-音频比较得出了较低的对接感知误差和更好的同步分数. 替换-音频实验在没有单独的口腔编辑模型的情况下检查了视觉被欺骗的情况,本地AIGC的例子说明了在更大的场景中面部区域的恢复情况. 组件比较将观察到的行为与音频调节、源-噪音混合和结构化的参考注射相连接。 这些结果共同支持了下游面部修复和假面的参考指导方法.

blocks.en: Reconstructed facial detail is a generative estimate, not evidence of true appearance. Because audio-driven editing can facilitate impersonation, applications should obtain appropriate permission and clearly disclose edited content.
blocks.zh: 被重建的面部细节是一种基因估计,而不是真实外观的证据. 由于音频驱动的编辑可以方便冒用,应用程序应获得适当许可并明确披露所编辑的内容.
